ITA-4.5.22 balasamprāptiḥ बलसम्प्राप्तिः
Intensity-specific pathogenesis
Pathogenesis subclassification based on the strength of the disease or condition.

ITA-5.63.60 balāsaḥ बलासः
Inflammatory swelling of throat
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a large swelling in the throat; pain in throat; breathlessness/difficulty in breathing; affecting/damaging vital parts or marmasthāna.

ITA-5.66.57 balāsakaḥ बलासकः
Conjunctival cyst
A disorder characterized by a growth resembling a water drop and having a bell metal lustre occurring in the white sclera of eye and neither soft nor painful; resembling water drops; hard swelling; painless swelling; reddish swelling; extensive swelling; heaviness; smooth/unctuous/oily.

ITA-9.1.18 baliḥ बलिः
Offerings to deity excluding animal sacrifice
A type of therapeutic ritual: treatment of a disease whereby something auspicious is offered to the deity to cure the ailment.

ITA-9.4.4 bālaḥ बालः
Child
The child between one and 16 years of age.

bālacikitsā, kaumārabhṛtyam बालचिकित्सा, कौमारभृत्यम्
Child and maternal health
The clinical speciality of Ayurveda dealing with child and maternal health and obstetrics; its scope extends to cover pre- and postnatal care.

ITA-9.4.43 bālabheṣajamātrā बालभेषजमात्रा
Paediatric drug dosage
A term indicating the special drug dosage patterns for the paediatric age-group.

ITA-5.71.1 bālarogaḥ बालरोगः
Paediatric diseases
Diseases of children aged between birth and 16 years.
